security_spec.violation_condition: QEMU TCG translates vdot4a/vdot4au/vdot4asu/vdot4aus instructions without checking that SEW==32, allowing execution with reserved SEW values (e.g., SEW=8, 16, or 64) which the spec explicitly reserves. The instruction operates on 4-element groups packed within a SEW-bit bundle; when SEW!=32, the element group boundaries and sub-element extraction logic would be undefined, potentially accessing misaligned vector register state or reading/writing beyond intended element boundaries.
security_spec.summary: Undefined-behavior for reserved SEW values in Zvdot4a8i dot-product instructions risks data corruption via incorrect sub-element extraction from vector registers when SEW!=32

findings.finding: Zvdot4a8i extension instructions (vdot4a, vdot4au, vdot4asu, vdot4aus) are not yet implemented in this QEMU tree. No translation functions, helper functions, opcode decode entries, or CSR definitions for these instructions exist in target/riscv/. The PR adding this extension is still in the review stage and has not been merged.
findings.snippet: No relevant code exists in target/riscv/ for these instructions.
